answer_1.quote: We demonstrate our method on the Moroccan and Egyptian Arabic dialects ... evaluating its performance on tasks involving language understanding, translation, and alignment with cultural knowledge and values.
answer_1.outputs: synthetic texts (stories, personal essays, blog posts, reviews, conversations), translations, model responses for cultural knowledge and value alignment

answer_2.quote: We conduct evaluations ... reporting results using ChrF++ and spBLEU scores.

answer_3.quote: We adopt an LLM-as-Judge methodology, employing Gemma-3-27b to rate the correctness of model-generated responses compared to ground-truth answers on a scale from 0 to 10.

answer_4.quote: Expert human annotator rated 100 randomly sampled items per dataset. ... rating correctness and dialectness on 1-5 scales.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each item for correctness and dialectness using a 1-5 Likert scale.
